workItems.title: [Report Designer] Web-based Report Management
workItems.description:
Placeholder � scope and requirements to be refined. Covers web-based equivalents of WPF Report Designer's Reports tab (template list) actions: create/rename/delete/organize templates and folders, Master/Project/Regime report type management, Export/Import template (XML), Permissions (Read/Update/Delete/Assign, folder-inherited), and the Edit Using Excel live-edit round-trip (open question: relevance once reports live in a web-based spreadsheet component). Sibling to 1865781 [Report Designer] Webify the Excel based editor, which covers the Report Template tab (layout, variable linking, groups, preview, migration).

Mockup is general - where there are inconsistencies with Econ UI patterns the implemented UI wins. Interactive html is attached - download and open.

workItems.acceptanceCriteria:
Acceptance Criteria
  • Template & Folder List
    • The Manage Reports screen must present two views of templates: an "All Reports" view listing every template (searchable by name substring), and a "Master List" view showing only templates currently designated as Master Reports � matching desktop Report Designer behavior.
    • Templates must be organizable into folders, including nested folders.
  • Create, Rename, Delete
    • A user must be able to create a new report template as either a Standard Report or a One Line Summary Report, or create a new folder, within a selected folder.
    • Creating a template must prompt for a name before it is added to the folder's list.
    • A user must be able to rename an existing template or folder.
    • A user must be able to delete an existing template or folder, subject to a confirmation step before the deletion is applied. This Feature does not need to define what happens to a template's existing usages elsewhere (Project/Regime links, scratchpad/result set reports); that is owned by the features that consume templates.
  • Report Type Management
    • Each template in the list must display its report type: Master Report, Project Report, Regime Report, or none.
    • A user must be able to add a template to, or remove it from, the Master Reports designation from this screen; a template designated as a Master Report must be visible on the Reports tab of every project in the hierarchy.
    • Creating or removing a Project Report link (via Manage Inputs) or a Regime Report link (via the Regime Library) is out of scope for this screen � this screen only reflects and lets a user filter/search by the resulting type, it does not create those links.
  • Export / Import Template
    • A user must be able to export a selected template to a local XML file.
    • A user must be able to import a template from an XML file into a selected folder.
  • Permissions
    • Permissions (Read, Update, Delete, Assign) must be assignable per template and per folder, to individual users or to workgroups.
    • Read grants viewing the template (and using it in reporting); Update grants modifying a template or folder; Delete grants deleting a template or folder; Assign grants changing permissions on it.
    • A new template or folder must inherit its parent folder's permissions by default.
    • Changing a folder's permissions must support applying the change to: this node only (default), this node and all child nodes, all child nodes only, this node and all parent nodes, or this node and all child and parent nodes.
